user.title: Fronius Modbus TCP
user.description: Connect to a Fronius device via Modbus TCP. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the device.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the device.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus device address of the inverter (usually 1).

error.not_sunspec: The device responded but no SunSpec data was found.
